text:
Mia: Heads-up — seeing JSON parse failures from the latest int8 AWQ build when using function-calling. Repro attached in a few examples below.

Mia: Example model output (copied from the harness):
```
{
  "tool": "search",
  "args": {
    "q": "redwood inference quantization tips",
    "filters": ["docs", "benchmarks"]
  }
  // <-- missing closing brace here (unclosed)
```

Mia: Parser throws: `JSONDecodeError: Expecting ',' delimiter: line 6 column 3 (char 142)`. Happens inconsistently across batches.

Raj: I can repro on my machine with AWQ-int8 too, lower frequency on AWQ-fp8 but nonzero. Repro steps: run the batch harness with streaming off and deterministic seed. Errors spike when sequence length crosses ~480 tokens. Log: 
```
2026-03-19 13:14:02 | model_response: '{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"...","filters":["docs"]}'
2026-03-19 13:14:02 | json_parse_error: JSONDecodeError pos=95
```

Raj: Hypothesis: kernel rounding + tokenization boundary leads to truncated output (KV cache flush?). Also check whether we accidentally strip a trailing `}` when applying micro-batching.

Sam: Suggestions for bisect/testing:
- reproduce with `--seed 42 --streaming=false`
- run across quantization commits and runtime versions
- enable `--emit-full-log` to capture raw token stream
Command I'm using:
```
python eval/run_toolcall_tests.py --model models/awq-int8-latest --seed 42 --streaming=false --emit-full-log > out.log
```

Sam: If you can attach `out.log` I can diff token streams between good/bad runs.

Luis: Short-term mitigation: add a schema-guard step before tool call. If validator fails, fall back to the fp16/gptq model for that request and emit a metric. We can do that in the router (cheap) until we pinpoint root cause.

Mia: Good call. Also, please add a fast JSON closure heuristic in the postprocess to catch a single missing `}` and attempt safe repair (log and increment a counter). That reduces user impact while we bisect.

Raj: I started a quick bisect across AWQ commits 2026-03-10..2026-03-18. Early sign: failure rate jumps after commit `awq/optimize-prefix-emit` (build 20260316). Will narrow down.

DeployBot: Canary deploy 2026-03-19T15:04Z to awq-int8 pool completed (canary=3 hosts). No infra errors reported.

Sam: Plan: Sam+Raj run full bisect and token-diff today, Mia adds schema guard + heuristic, Luis wires fallback routing + metric alert (err_rate > 0.5% over 30m). If fallback triggers, auto-route to dedicated fp16 pool.

Luis: I'll add the metric dashboard and a temporary rollout policy.

Mia: I'll open a quick PR for the validator + heuristic, link tests.

Raj: I'll paste the current bisect job link when ready.

Sam: Also checking whether `--batch-size` changes frequency. Early note: smaller batch size seems slightly better. Could be batching truncation bug.

Mia: Thanks — tagging @Sam @Raj @Luis. Will follow-up with a short postmortem if we find root cause. :thumbsup:
